question: The degrees of freedom of the intragroup variance in a 1-way Anova comparing 4 groups of 10 individuals each are:
analysis: In a 1-way ANOVA, the degrees of freedom for the intragroup variance is calculated as (n-1) where n is the number of groups being compared. In this case, there are 4 groups of 10 individuals each, so the degrees of freedom would be (10-1) * 4 = 36.
